The complete corresponding JavaScript source used to build single-file.bundle.js
is included, unmodified, in single-file-core/. Its LICENSE is included there.
Third-party notices and licenses are retained in those sources and the bundle.
The bundle is a generated transformation; it is not an unmodified upstream file.
After npm ci, reproduce it with: node scripts/build-html-vendor.mjs
The build uses the exact esbuild version pinned in package-lock.json.

The extension's SingleFile integration, including html-export.js, is distributed
under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Its corresponding source is included in the extension
and in the Firefox MCP source package. SingleFile has no runtime download or
remote service dependency in this integration.
